    override fun visitAttribute(context: XmlContext, attribute: Attr) {

        val value = attribute.value ?: return

            reportInvalid(context, attribute, "The motion scene file `res/xml/$name.xml` could not be found.")
        }
    }

    private fun reportInvalid(context: XmlContext, attribute: Attr, message: String) {
        context.report(

            context.getValueLocation(attribute),
            message

    }

class MotionLayoutDetector : Detector(), Detector.XmlScanner {

    override fun appliesTo(folderType: ResourceFolderType): Boolean =
        folderType == ResourceFolderType.LAYOUT

    override fun getApplicableElements(): Collection<String>? =
        MOTION_LAYOUT_TAGS

    override fun visitElement(context: XmlContext, element: Element) {
        val attr = element.getAttributeNodeNS(
            SdkConstants.AUTO_URI,
            SdkConstants.ATTR_CONSTRAINT_LAYOUT_DESCRIPTION
        )

        if (attr == null) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                element,
                context.getNameLocation(element),
                "MotionLayout requires a `app:layoutDescription` attribute referencing a motion scene file"
            )
            return
        }

        validateSceneReference(context, attr)
    }

    override fun getApplicableAttributes(): Collection<String>? =
        listOf(SdkConstants.ATTR_CONSTRAINT_LAYOUT_DESCRIPTION)

    override fun visitAttribute(context: XmlContext, attribute: Attr) {
        // Only validate layoutDescription on MotionLayout elements
        val element = attribute.ownerElement
        if (!MOTION_LAYOUT_TAGS.contains(element.tagName)) {
            return
        }
        validateSceneReference(context, attribute)
    }

    private fun validateSceneReference(context: XmlContext, attr: Attr) {
        val value = attr.value ?: ""
        if (value.isBlank() || !value.startsWith("@xml/")) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                attr,
                context.getValueLocation(attr),
                "The `app:layoutDescription` attribute must reference a motion scene file in `res/xml/`"
            )
            return
        }

        val sceneName = value.substring(5)
        if (sceneName.isBlank() || sceneName.contains("/")) {

                ISSUE,
                attr,
                context.getValueLocation(attr),
                "The `app:layoutDescription` attribute must reference a motion scene file in `res/xml/`"
            )
            return
        }

        val exists = context.project.resourceFolders.any { resFolder ->
            File(resFolder, "xml/$sceneName.xml").exists()
        }

        if (!exists) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                attr,
                context.getValueLocation(attr),
                "The motion scene file `res/xml/$sceneName.xml` could not be found"
            )
        }
    }

        private val MOTION_LAYOUT_TAGS = listOf(
            "androidx.constraintlayout.motion.widget.MotionLayout",
            "android.support.constraint.motion.widget.MotionLayout"
        )

        const val KEY_URL = "https://developer.android.com/training/constraint-layout/motionlayout"

            priority = 6,
            severity = Severity.ERROR,
            implementation = Implementation(
                MotionLayoutDetector::class.java,
                Scope.RESOURCE_FILE_SCOPE
            )
        )
    }
}

import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.XmlContext
import org.w3c.dom.Attr

class MotionLayoutDetector : Detector(), Detector.XmlScanner {

    override fun appliesTo(folderType: ResourceFolderType): Boolean =
        folderType == ResourceFolderType.LAYOUT

    override fun getApplicableElements(): Collection<String>? =
        MOTION_LAYOUT_TAGS

    override fun visitElement(context: XmlContext, element: Element) {

            SdkConstants.AUTO_URI,

        )

            )
            return
        }

        val value = attr.value ?: ""
        if (value.isBlank() || !value.startsWith("@xml/")) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                attr,
                context.getValueLocation(attr),
                "layoutDescription must specify a scene file"
            )
            return
        }

        val sceneName = value.substring(5)
        if (sceneName.isBlank() || sceneName.contains("/")) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                attr,
                context.getValueLocation(attr),
                "layoutDescription must specify a scene file"
            )
            return
        }

        val exists = context.project.resourceFolders.any { resFolder ->
            File(resFolder, "xml/$sceneName.xml").exists()
        }

        if (!exists) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                attr,
                context.getValueLocation(attr),
                "The motion scene file `res/xml/$sceneName.xml` could not be found"
            )
        }
    }

    companion object {
        const val KEY_URL = "https://developer.android.com/training/constraint-layout/motionlayout"

        private val MOTION_LAYOUT_TAGS = listOf(

            "androidx.constraintlayout.motion.widget.MotionLayout",
            "android.support.constraint.motion.widget.MotionLayout"
        )

            moreInfo = KEY_URL,
            category = Category.CORRECTNESS,
            priority = 6,
            severity = Severity.ERROR,
            implementation = Implementation(
                MotionLayoutDetector::class.java,
                Scope.RESOURCE_FILE_SCOPE
            )
        )
    }
}
